_comment: Example ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Merge the servers you want; never paste a token here.
Prefer OAuth servers (no secret on disk). For token servers, use ${env:VAR} or the Keychain wrapper.
Team skills MCP: pin a tag or main. Never pin a feature branch; it disappears when its PR merges and the server then fails quietly.
Jira: no MCP server. Agents use Atlassian's CLI (acli); sign in once with: acli jira auth login --web
